column3: n. 祸根, 毒药, 灭亡的原因, 灭亡;毒物, 毒, 毒药
column5: Late buses are the bane of every commuter in this growing city.
column6: 公交晚点是这座发展中城市所有通勤者的心头大患。

column3: n. 专制君主, 暴君;暴君, 专制君主
column5: The play depicts a despot who slowly loses control of his own court.
column6: 该剧描写一位逐渐失去对宫廷掌控的暴君。

column3: a. 廉价而俗丽的;n. 廉价而俗丽之物
column5: The award ceremony felt tawdry, all plastic trophies and cheap confetti.
column6: 颁奖典礼显得俗气，全是塑料奖杯和廉价彩带。

column3: n. 菊花
column5: Each autumn the town fills its parks with chrysanthemum displays in every shade.
column6: 每年秋天，镇上的公园都摆满各色菊花造型。

column3: vt. 扩展...以上, 过度伸张, 走过头;vi. 伸得过远, 过分, 过火
column5: Critics fear the regulator may overreach by taxing small online sellers.
column6: 批评者担心监管机构向小网商征税会越权。

column3: a. 全知的, 无所不知的;n. 无所不知者, 上帝
column5: No single narrator is omniscient, and the novel deliberately exposes each bias.
column6: 没有全知的叙述者，小说刻意暴露每一处偏见。

column3: a. 容易溅开的, 泥泞的, 遍布斑点的
column5: The startup made a splashy entrance with billboards across the entire subway system.
column6: 这家初创公司大手笔投放地铁广告，高调亮相。

column3: n. 部下, 下手, 下属
column5: The director delegated the tedious paperwork to a nervous underling each quarter.
column6: 主管每季度都把乏味的文书工作交给一名胆怯的下属。

column3: a. 身材瘦长的
column5: The gangly teenager grew four inches and suddenly dominated the basketball court.
column6: 这个瘦长少年长高了四英寸，突然称霸篮球场。

column3: a. 精神错乱的, 疯狂的
column5: The thriller's deranged antagonist leaves cryptic clues for the detective to decode.
column6: 这部惊悚片中精神错乱的反派给侦探留下神秘线索。

column3: n. 滑移, 滑动, 滑程;延误
column5: The report blames schedule slippage on unclear requirements and constant design changes.
column6: 报告把进度延误归咎于需求不清和频繁改动设计。

column3: a. 偏离正路的, 偏离常轨的, 畸变的;异常的
column5: The sensor flagged aberrant readings minutes before the pipeline pressure dropped.
column6: 传感器在管道压力骤降前数分钟标记了异常读数。

column3: a. 好辩的；好争论的；挑起论战的
column5: His polemical essays angered both political parties during the turbulent campaign season.
column6: 他论战性的文章在激烈的竞选期间激怒了两党。

column3: n. 边缘, 轮缘, 凸缘;vt. 装凸缘
column5: A cracked flange on the pipeline joint forced an emergency shutdown.
column6: 管道接头处的法兰盘开裂，迫使系统紧急停机。

column3: a. 未遂的, 不受约束的, 独立于...的, 自由的, 不负义务的, 未被监禁的;不受约束的
column5: Many voters remain uncommitted until the final presidential debate is over.
column6: 许多选民要等到最后一场总统辩论结束才做决定。

column3: n. 广大, 无边, 巨物
column5: Standing at the canyon's rim, she grasped the immensity of geological time.
column6: 站在峡谷边缘，她领略到地质时间的浩瀚无边。

column3: n. 庸医;庸医, 江湖医
column5: The wellness industry attracts the occasional charlatan promising instant cures.
column6: 保健行业偶尔会招来许诺速效疗法的江湖骗子。

column3: vt. 定界, 分开, 区别
column5: Treaty negotiations began to demarcate the disputed border along the river.
column6: 条约谈判开始沿河流划定有争议的边界。

column3: n. 逐渐变化, 分等级, 阶级, 顺序;阶度
column5: The training program follows a careful gradation from basic drills to live emergencies.
column6: 培训课程遵循由基础演练到真实突发事件的渐进梯度。

column3: n. 祝福
column5: The villagers gathered for a final benediction before the old church closed.
column6: 老教堂关闭前，村民们聚在一起接受最后的祝福。

column3: v. (使)连结, (使)连锁;n. 连锁, 连结
column5: The safety systems interlock so that one alarm triggers the entire shutdown.
column6: 各安全系统相互联锁，一个警报就会触发全部关停。

column3: vt. 风狂吹, 咆哮, 汹涌;vi. 咆哮着说出, 恐吓
column5: The manager would bluster at staff whenever quarterly numbers disappointed the board.
column6: 每当季度业绩令董事会失望，经理就会对员工咆哮。

column3: n. 倔强, 顽固, 固执行为, (疼痛等)难治
column5: His obstinacy in negotiation cost the firm a lucrative multiyear contract.
column6: 他在谈判中的固执让公司丢掉一份丰厚的多年合同。

column3: a. 不愿向前走的, 倔强的, 难驾御的
column5: The crowd grew restive as the delayed train announcements kept changing.
column6: 列车晚点通告反复变化，人群变得焦躁难安。

column3: n. 丰盛;外侧隐窝(第四脑室)
column5: The market stall offered a cornucopia of spices from three continents.
column6: 市场摊位上摆满来自三大洲的各色香料。

column3: v. 狂饮, 暴食, 喝酒化掉(钱)
column5: Data centers guzzle enormous amounts of electricity to keep servers cool.
column6: 数据中心为给服务器降温要消耗巨量电力。

column3: vt. 使适应, 使服水土;vi. 服水土, 适应新环境
column5: New employees need several weeks to acclimate to the firm's rapid workflow.
column6: 新员工需要几周时间适应公司快节奏的工作流程。

column3: n. 学者, 专家
column5: The local savant could identify any bird from a two-second recording.
column6: 当地的行家听两秒录音就能辨认任何鸟类。

column3: n. 油膏, 药膏, 安慰, 奉承话;vt. 涂油膏于, 安慰, 缓和, 抢救, 打捞
column5: The nurse applied a cooling salve to the walker's blistered heels.
column6: 护士给徒步者磨破的脚跟涂上清凉的药膏。

column3: a. 男性的;男性的, 有男性征的
column5: The novel's hero is a virile explorer with a troubled past.
column6: 小说主人公是一位身世坎坷、充满男子气概的探险家。
